name: S Hotels and Resorts Public Company Limited
summary: S Hotels and Resorts Public Company Limited engages in the investment, hospitality, and related businesses in Thailand and internationally. It offers a portfolio of 39 properties to guests in the Republic of Maldives, the Republic of Fiji, the Republic of Mauritius, the United Kingdom, and Thailand. The company is based in Bangkok, Thailand. S Hotels and Resorts Public Company Limited is a subsidiary of Singha Estate Public Company Limited.
